tie_handling: first action in registered allowed_actions order
initial_belief: instance initial_state_distribution; reset for counterfactual decision query
observation_update: condition on jointly observed reward and observation after each action
policy_scope: one nonanticipative observation-contingent policy shared by all candidate models
reward_accumulation: undiscounted sum of per-step registered integer rewards
off_support_branch: first registered action at every remaining step
planner: minimize maximum model regret over candidate support against model-wise full-information optimum
horizon_10_status: optional; do not claim validated until full exact control run
